Title: Vikram's Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 33 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Neeta - 57 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Karan - 38 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Vikram stands in the ward. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Vikram, what's the plan today?"

[Vikram checks Mother's pulse.]

Neeta: "Good job, Vikram!"

[Vikram lies down on the hospital bed.]

Vikram: "That's easy."

[Vikram sits in a wheelchair.]

Neeta: "Well done!"

[Vikram walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Neeta (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[Vikram coughs and holds his chest.]

Vikram (softly): "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Vikram stands on the terrace. Karan stands near him.]

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[Vikram ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Karan: "How beautiful!"

[Vikram reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Vikram: "One more time!"

[Vikram falls from the roof and dies.]

Karan (excited): "Rest in peace."
